findings.title: IDOR via Base64-Encoded User ID in Cookie
findings.description: The application uses a cookie (access_token) containing a base64-encoded user ID to control access. By changing the cookie value to base64-encoded 'Mg==' (user ID 2), an attacker can access other companies' data.
